extraction.text:
SUMMARY:

Strategic Procurement & Contract Management professional with experience across global banking and manufacturing organizations including UBS Business Solutions India Pvt Ltd, Credit Suisse Services India Pvt Ltd, HSBC Software Development India Ltd, and Cummins India Ltd.

Expertise in Source-to-Contract (S2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Vendor Risk Management (TPRM), contract lifecycle management, digital tool implementation (Ivalua, DocuSign).

SKILLS:

▪

Strategic Sourcing & Vendor Negotiation

▪ Contract Lifecycle Management

(CLM)

▪ TPRM & Vendor Risk Framework ▪ Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Operations ▪ RFP & Supplier Evaluation ▪ UAT & System Implementation ▪ Procurement Transformation Stakeholder & Executive ▪ Engagement

▪ Compliance & Quality Audit Review ▪ Power BI, Ivalua, DocuSign, Coupa,

SirionLabs

▪ Process Improvement (Lean / Kaizen

Yellow Belt)

EDUCATION:

▪ MBA – Supply Chain Management

from AISSMS Pune University; 2016 – 66%

▪ Bachelor of Engineering –

Electronics from AISSMS Pune University; 2006 - 65.04%

SMITA KUDALE

Phone: +91-9011280800 | Email: smita.kudale6@gmail.com LinkedIn: Smita Kudale | LinkedIn | Location: Pune, Maharashtra

COMPETENCIES:

▪ Source to Contract:



Sourcing and vendor management for Non-IT facility products & services.

 Handled end-to-end management of vendor agreements, including annual maintenance contracts and service-level commitments. Stakeholders coordination liaise with internal teams – risk, compliance, legal.



▪ Proficiency in enterprise systems and digital tool:



Leveraged digital tools like Power Bi, Copilot, AI agents to facilitate functions.

 Played a key role in enabling digital contract execution by

supporting onboard Docu-Sign (e-signature tool) for signing third-party legal agreements.

 Executed system user acceptance testing for procurement and requisition processes in release deployment of tool MyShop and Ivalua.

▪ Training and Communications:





Facilitated onboarding and upskilling by creating instructional content for sourcing, requisition, and contract management tools, DORA, TPRM Framework, CM, VRM actions, etc. Leveraged the tools like Atlas Confluence, Articulate 360 to design and deliver engaging training materials, including user guides and instructional videos.

▪ Stakeholder Engagement:

 Partnered with executive leadership, internal clients, vendors

and cross-functional group to foster alignment and innovation.

 Established trusted stakeholder engagement to drive

business development and client satisfaction.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS:

▪ Promoted to AVP position at Credit Suisse (2020) ▪ Excellence Award – Client Focus at Credit Suisse (2018) ▪ Kaizen Yellow Belt Certification at Credit Suisse (2016) ▪ ▪ Excellence in Project Execution recognition at Cummins (2009)

Synergy Best Team Award – HSBC (2010)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

Project Manager

UBS Business Solutions India Pvt Ltd, Pune Since April 2023

▪ Contributed to UBS integration activities through preparation of upcoming banners, blackout messages, and

testing of functionalities for various tools like Ivalua, SirionLabs, and Coupa.

▪ Regularly updated Confluence with recent merger - integration changes, enhancements, and integration

information.

▪ Completed UBS tone of voice training to develop compliant video snacks and quick cards for training purposes. ▪ Developed training videos focused on Cyber and Security Information questionnaires for CM5 initiatives in the Logistics Platform, DORA, TPRM Framework, CM actions, VRM actions, CIS Attestations, understanding of risk ratings etc.

▪ Communications - Prepared distribution lists while creating informative content for supply chain

communications, with comprehensive useful links.

▪ Employed Xmail and Inxmail to disseminate communications regarding Ivalua system updates and LE

integration milestones.

▪ Managed supply chain mailbox, addressing queries efficiently and documenting responses. ▪

Leveraged digital tools lie Power Bi, Copilot and AI agents for optimising processes, content and reports.

Assistant Vice President – Procurement & Contracts

Credit Suisse Services India Pvt Ltd, Pune March 2013 – March 2023

▪ Enabled transitioning of procurement processes from manual and local systems to a global platform through

MVC tool implementation.

▪ Supported implementation of Ivalua tool for Contract and Requisition modules, ensuring process mapping and

data quality.

▪ Conducted User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for contracting, sourcing, and requisition modules to verify

functionality and compliance.

▪ Facilitated implementation of DocuSign tool for electronic execution of third-party contracts. ▪ Delivered training and user guidance for DocuSign, providing end-to-end support for global users. ▪ Performed Quality Audit Reviews (QAR) on global contracts across various categories to maintain compliance. ▪ Developed user guides and quick reference materials for Ivalua, tailored to diverse user roles. ▪ Generated reports in Ivalua based on contract and requisition queries received from stakeholders. ▪ Onboarded Confluence platform, migrating training materials to improve accessibility and user experience.

Executive – Procurement

HSBC Software Development India Ltd, Pune July 2009 – Feb 2013

▪ Delivered procurement of commodities, including building management systems, HVACs, and security systems.

Negotiated savings of ~ USD 21K.

▪ Facilitated RFP processes to evaluate submissions and prequalify vendors. ▪ Negotiated contracts with vendors, ensuring compliance with commercial terms.

▪ Conducted monthly performance monitoring of vendors to ensure SLA adherence. ▪ Documented savings under categorization codes for comprehensive financial analysis. ▪ Generated monthly MIS reports for effective performance tracking. ▪ Established annual maintenance and operations contracts across multiple commodities. ▪ Executed implementation of Buysmart Ariba system, focusing on India legal entity setup and testing.

Assistant Executive – Supply Chain

Cummins India Ltd, Pune Aug 2006 – March 2009

▪ Assisted in streamlining procurement processes for electronics and electrical materials aligned with MRP

system for manufacturing needs. Led project execution for global sourcing of domestic products effectively. Initiated vendor development and product innovation for electronic components.

▪ ▪ ▪ Supervised supply monitoring and stock management to maintain uninterrupted supply chains. ▪ Analyzed supplier quality and delivery monthly to improve operational performance. ▪ Collaborated on planning and scheduling production as per build rate and customer specifications with cross-

functional teams.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

▪ Enrolled for Data Analytics Certification program. ▪ ▪ ▪ Volunteer Work – Collaborate with Rotary club for social causes 2007-2009; active participation in office

Languages – English, Marathi, Hindi. Interests – Travelling, swimming, Kathak.

philanthropy events every year.

Project Manager
UBS Business Solutions India Pvt Ltd, Pune Since April 2023
▪ Contributed to UBS integration activities through preparation of upcoming banners, blackout messages, and
testing of functionalities for various tools like Ivalua, SirionLabs, and Coupa.
▪ Regularly updated Confluence with recent merger - integration changes, enhancements, and integration
information.
▪ Completed UBS tone of voice training to develop compliant video snacks and quick cards for training purposes. ▪ Developed training videos focused on Cyber and Security Information questionnaires for CM5 initiatives in the Logistics Platform, DORA, TPRM Framework, CM actions, VRM actions, CIS Attestations, understanding of risk ratings etc.
▪ Communications - Prepared distribution lists while creating informative content for supply chain
communications, with comprehensive useful links.
▪ Employed Xmail and Inxmail to disseminate communications regarding Ivalua system updates and LE
integration milestones.
▪ Managed supply chain mailbox, addressing queries efficiently and documenting responses. ▪
Leveraged digital tools lie Power Bi, Copilot and AI agents for optimising processes, content and reports.
Assistant Vice President – Procurement & Contracts
Credit Suisse Services India Pvt Ltd, Pune March 2013 – March 2023

MVC tool implementation.
▪ Supported implementation of Ivalua tool for Contract and Requisition modules, ensuring process mapping and
data quality.
▪ Conducted User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for contracting, sourcing, and requisition modules to verify
functionality and compliance.

Executive – Procurement
HSBC Software Development India Ltd, Pune July 2009 – Feb 2013
▪ Delivered procurement of commodities, including building management systems, HVACs, and security systems.

Cummins India Ltd, Pune Aug 2006 – March 2009
▪ Assisted in streamlining procurement processes for electronics and electrical materials aligned with MRP
system for manufacturing needs. Led project execution for global sourcing of domestic products effectively. Initiated vendor development and product innovation for electronic components.
▪ ▪ ▪ Supervised supply monitoring and stock management to maintain uninterrupted supply chains. ▪ Analyzed supplier quality and delivery monthly to improve operational performance. ▪ Collaborated on planning and scheduling production as per build rate and customer specifications with cross-
functional teams.
